title: Bhaje Vaayu Vegam
desc: A budding cricketer bets big to fund his father's surgery but is betrayed by a bookie. Seeking revenge, he lands on a crime website, facing unexpected dangers that test his resolve.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Jawaan
desc: Azad fights against the systemic oppression of society. Soon, he finds himself in a web of deceit and crime as he teams up with a group of allies to take down a ruthless arms dealer.

title: Kasam Paida Karne Wale Ki
desc: Aarti's husband gets killed by his paternal uncle in order to usurp his wealth and estate. She swears on her unborn child to avenge his death.

title: Bruce Lee
desc: Bruce Lee and his friends get into a fight with the close aides of Ramdoss, an evil don. When the gangster kidnaps Lee's girlfriend, he plans to rescue her.
